title: csoai.ruling/0.1
description: A signed record of one ruling. A ruling decides WHICH pre-registered rule applies, or WHETHER a rule's output is served, published, named or admitted. It never sets a measured state: SEPARATED, TIE, UNTESTED, MEASURED, UNMEASURED and ADMITTED/NOT_ADMITTED come only from pinned rules over pinned bytes. Where the question concerns a rule's output, that output is copied into rule_output with origin 'rule' and the commit that computed it; the ruling cannot author it. The reviewer panel is ADVISORY: the owner's ruling is binding until the panel's measured independence reaches n_eff >= 2. A JSON Schema cannot compare fields or walk key names at every depth, so the producer (scripts/rulings/ruling-lib.mjs) also refuses measured-state keys anywhere in the record, fault-tolerance vocabulary the panel has not earned, and a binding panel below n_eff 2. The signature is detached: Ed25519 under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 over signature.attestation, which commits to the record by content_id = sha256(RFC 8785 JCS of the record without 'signature').

ref.description: The doctrine, ADR, charter article or owner-rule this ruling applies, by name (e.g. 'Standing doctrine: UNMEASURED is first-class', 'ADR-002').

uri.description: https:// for a public byte source; git:<repo>@<40-hex commit>:<path> for a committed file.

of.description: What bytes the sha256 is over.

rule_output.description: null when the question is not about a rule's output. Otherwise the output exactly as the rule computed it. Recorded, never set: origin is always 'rule'.

key.description: The reviewer's own verification key, when it has one.

panel_state.description: NOT_CONVENED: no reviewer ran. ADVISORY: reviewers ran but measured n_eff < 2 (or unmeasured); the owner's ruling alone binds. INDEPENDENT: measured n_eff >= 2.

panel_n_eff.description: Effective number of independent reviewers by the council-independence method, as a decimal string, or UNMEASURED. A string, so RFC 8785 number formatting never enters the signed bytes.

binding.description: Who binds. OWNER until the panel's measured n_eff >= 2; 0.1 defines no other value.

owner_ruling_verbatim.description: The owner's words, quoted exactly from owner_ruling_source.where. The literal UNRECORDED when no first-hand quote exists; never a paraphrase presented as a quote.

verbatim_status.description: QUOTED: the source shows the owner's words in quotation marks. AS_RECORDED: the source's own entry text, which records the ruling without quotation marks. UNRECORDED: no first-hand record of the words exists.

effective_from.description: An ISO date/datetime, or the event the ruling takes effect on (e.g. 'the next board re-sign').
